knownDeltas: The href host is the in-process test server (http://localhost); Esri's sample href points at sampleserver6. The export envelope (width/height/extent/scale) is the parity contract.
Rendered pixels are engine-native and covered structurally by mapserver-export-image, never byte-compared here.
name: mapserver-export
notes: Export envelope (MapServer/export?f=json): the doc-pattern bbox/size/format over the published map; the replay pins the image href plus dimensions, extent and scale.
source: Esri REST docs: Export Map (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/export-map.htm); bbox/bboxSR/imageSR/size/format pattern
